speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for Manpower whether the Ministry will consider (i) expanding the Foreign Construction Worker Directory (FCWD) System to other sectors, such as the cleaning sector and (ii) incorporating the FCWD portal on mobile applications targeted at foreign workers.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: I was just wondering whether we can extend this to the cleaning sector because I think the cleaning sector, like the construction sector, is quite cyclical as well.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: A lot of the contracts are for two years.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: So, a lot of these cleaners who come to Singapore to work and gain their experience sometimes go back within the two years.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: It will benefit both the cleaners and the companies to hire the skilled workers in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: The second question I would like to ask is whether we can then incentivise the hiring of the existing workers who are in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: This directory will be more effective if we can incentivise, in a sense, maybe provide a reduced foreign worker levy if they hire workers already in Singapore.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: Services tend to be for longer periods, for example, as mentioned, it could be two years.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: It depends on the length of the contract.

speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
text: The second difference is that when you look at Construction, for example, SCAL, as an industry association, championed it and, therefore, the database was set up and agreed upon by employers.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: The Clerk will now proceed to read the Orders of the Day.
